summary: Scalar-deleting destructor pattern. Calls ObjectInitWithVTableCleanup on this (vtable-teardown sub-call), then conditionally frees the object via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the low bit of the a2 deletion-flag argument is set, and returns this. The legacy ABI symbol names it Destructor_with_Sub_Call_and_Conditional_Free_47c7f0 but carries no prototype.

local_names.this: object being destroyed; passed to the teardown sub-call and to the conditional free
local_names.a2: deletion flag; bit 0 selects whether the object storage is freed

operations.description: ObjectInitWithVTableCleanup(this): invoke the vtable-teardown sub-call on the object
if ((a2 & 1) != 0): test the low bit of the deletion flag before freeing
FreeWrapper_7bcf(this): free the object storage when the flag bit is set
Return this; standard scalar-deleting destructor pattern
